GNU Unifont 18.0.01 (https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/unifont/unifont-18.0.01/unifont-18.0.01.bdf.gz),
wide (16x16) glyphs for U+3000-30FF, U+4E00-9FFF, U+AC00-D7A3 and U+FF01-FF60, repacked
by scripts/bake_unifont.py into wide-16.bin (1 bit a pixel, 32 bytes a glyph; MODIFIED only
in that it is repacked and the other glyphs are dropped).
